products.name: InternLM (Shanghai AI Lab)
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; academic research; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-affiliated research institution in China operating InternLM, an open-source large language model positioned for academic research across Chinese universities and scientific applications.

The laboratory's stated focus spans model capability, embodied robotics, and AI safety frameworks, with recent emphasis on science-oriented systems that integrate language models, specialist agents, and physical automation. This portfolio suggests a research strategy prioritizing broad capability development rather than any single domain constraint. The 2026 announcement of AI-for-science results and a scientific discovery platform indicates the institution is testing large models as infrastructure for experimental workflows, from hypothesis through validation.

What matters for AI infrastructure is that Shanghai AI Laboratory operates within China's university and research ecosystem, not as a commercial infrastructure builder or power provider. The laboratory contributes to model capability and research methodology but does not control the compute, buildings, or power grids that determine how quickly those capabilities can scale. It represents the downstream user of infrastructure, not the constraint that binds it.

The data does not cover the laboratory's budget, its access to compute hardware, or the power requirements of its training and inference systems. Without those facts, the connection between its research ambitions and the infrastructure constraints that may or may not enable them remains unmeasured.

profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government laboratory, listed as not for profit, with its site at shlab.org.cn. It describes itself as recruiting young talent worldwide in artificial intelligence, large models, embodied intelligence, trustworthy AI, AI for Science, foundational platforms, the innovation chain, and management support, toward what it calls a shared AGI future. Since 2022 it says it has run a joint doctoral training program with Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tongji University, the University of Science and Technology of China, Zhejiang University, and more than ten top universities.

Its tracked product is InternLM, listed under chat and general LLMs as a Chinese open-source large language model, noted for academic research with cross-border data review advised. The site describes a general and specialized integration system in three dependent layers: a foundation model layer for general capability and high-density supervised specialist capability, a fusion and coordination layer built across multiple routes, and an exploration and evolution layer for self-improvement through autonomous exploration and correction. It also describes an AI-45 degree balance law, under which safety and performance should track a 45 degree line over the long term, and a causal path to trustworthy AGI through three stages it calls alignment, intervenability, and reflection. For embodied intelligence it points to the full-stack engine Inno-Robotics, which it says addresses data, training, and application across the chain.

On research releases, the laboratory says that at the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum AI-enabled scientific research forum it upgraded and released the 书生·端砚 scientific discovery platform and fully opened its full-stack services, combining compute, proof, and verification. It released the 书生 physical world model W0, and at the 2026 WA Science Frontier Forum it released ten joint scientific intelligence innovation results with universities, research institutions, and industry partners, covering life sciences, materials science, and deep astronomy. It describes the 书生 scientific multimodal large model S2 and says vision, force, and touch have been combined and connected to 书生·端砚 to support dry and wet experiments including gene editing protein directed evolution, mepivacaine organic synthesis, and lipid nanoparticle synthesis. Professor 周伯文 proposed that scientific research is the next programming, with AI and science advancing together. The site also mentions a digital twin platform, an intelligent verification matrix, and a data evolution flywheel, and a "North Star" talent program.
